title: Liliia was a fantastic...
text: Liliia was a fantastic tour guide, showing some of the fabulous street art and lesser known parts of Barcelona. A unique twist on the city vs the tours of all the regular tourists spots. Also gave excellent recommendations for coffee and other bars/restaurants to check out. Would recommend for anyone not looking to see the same places as everyone else
author: Michael_G

title: Great experience in Barcelona!
text: Liliia is a master of what she is doing. The topic is very interesting the way how she communicate with people is charming. And the tour in general is captivating journey through Barcelona’s street art, striking sculptures, and dark real stories and legends. I would recommend this tour to everybody.
author: _O9404WM

title: Great experience
text: This tour is a real treasure for anyone wanting to discover the city's hidden gems. Lilia's enthusiasm and knowledge really brought the stories behind the amazing street art to life. It’s not just a sightseeing trip; it’s an immersive experience that explores Barcelona’s fascinating culture and mysterious history. If you love urban art, history, and a bit of the spooky side, this tour is a must-do!
author: _H6078PA

title: Very cool tour
text: An amazing tour, really unique way to discover the city’s hidden gems, showcasing vibrant street art and local talent!
author: Izmeshkanapol

title: Well worth while
text: Lillia was very knowledgeable in all things street art. Answered our questions and gave us a great recommendation for lunch.
author: Robin_A

title: Brilliant tour of local culture
text: Fantastic tour! Really interesting, starting around the El Raval area and finishing by El Born. Liliia was super friendly and took her time to explain to us lots of interesting history of the various areas and context behind the street art. Plus she gave us some great recommendations for Barcelona in general. Thanks, Liliia!
author: Tom_D

title: See all the art and hear all the stories behind them
text: Went in Feb 2023. Great tour. Liliia is very knowledgeable and personable. Really enjoyed the tour and experience!
author: Sarah_C

title: Sign up!!
text: Leila was perfect guide very knowledgeable and professional! Its turn out to be a private tour only for me since no one registered and it was amazing!! Very recommended

title: Don’t miss this great tour!
text: Great knowledge of Barcelona street artists as well as history and background information. Thoughtful walking path. Recommend!
author: Josh_W

title: Great tour, small group and good conversation
text:
Liliia was a great tour guide, she asked us some interesting questions about art, told us some great history of the area, and was very knowledgeable about the surrounding area. She stopped to show us several small things that we would have otherwise missed, and also took us to some famous places that we didn't know about.

It was a very intimate tour as there were only three people, this made for a nice conversation and allowed for many questions / interesting discussion!
author: anthonyspercipient
